testcase.name: every route requires a token including health; browser-origin requests are rejected
health is independent of WhatsApp and responses cannot be cached
foundation sending is closed by default and denies non-approved numbers
approved test recipient still requires connected session
invalid payloads, remote media and arbitrary administrative fields are rejected
installed Chromium runs with its sandbox; actual WhatsApp driver is loadable
link exposes temporary QR only through material, never status
disconnect retains persisted session and reconnect uses it
restart restores intent without sending; intentional disconnect stays disconnected
replace logs out old account, clears number and accepts only newly proven number
offline logout cannot pretend to revoke the account
errors never expose raw library data, and unknown send is not retried
concurrent commands are rejected while sending, not queued
Windows ACL protection, token durability and atomic session state survive reconstruction
